description: SAFE rule set contains only FULL recommendation types
setup: Populate repository with rules for SAFE; call validate_rule_set(rules; 'SAFE')
expected_outcome: No error raised; all conclusion_types ∈ {Go; Delay; DepartureTime; Duration}

description: CAUTION rule set excludes DepartureTime and Duration
setup: Populate repository with CAUTION rules having conclusion_type ∈ {Go; Delay}; call validate_rule_set(rules; 'CAUTION')

description: CAUTION rule set with DepartureTime is rejected
setup: Insert a rule with applicable_state=CAUTION and conclusion_type=DepartureTime; call validate_rule_set
expected_outcome: ConfigurationError raised; S not modified; no advisory created
Empty list or ConfigurationError (UNSAFE is excluded from supply); no advisory

setup: Populate repository with a rule violating conclusion_type ∉ A_AI(CAUTION); trigger validate_rule_set
expected_outcome: ConfigurationError raised; Layer 3 disabled for episode; S unchanged

description: Engine cannot fire rule outside active RS
setup: Load RS(CAUTION); attempt to fire rule with conclusion_type=DepartureTime that is NOT in RS(CAUTION)
expected_outcome: Rule is not present in RS(CAUTION); cannot be fired; advisory list excludes DepartureTime

description: Empty rule firing result is valid
setup: Load a valid RS(SAFE) or RS(CAUTION); execute_episode where no rule conditions are satisfied
expected_outcome: Advisory list is empty; no error raised; FidelityTrace emitted with fired_rule_ids=[]

setup: Two rules in RS(SAFE) fire simultaneously (Go and DepartureTime); both conclusion_types ∈ A_AI(SAFE)
expected_outcome: Advisory list contains both; FidelityTrace records both advisory types; no violation

setup: Execute episode under SAFE; transition to CAUTION; execute new episode
expected_outcome: New episode uses RS(CAUTION) only; DepartureTime and Duration absent from active_rule_ids in FidelityTrace

setup: Execute episode under CAUTION; transition to UNSAFE
expected_outcome: New episode: G=0; no rule_set supplied; advisory list empty; FidelityTrace records S_old=CAUTION; S_new=UNSAFE

setup: Execute episode under UNSAFE; transition to SAFE
expected_outcome: New episode: G=1; RS(SAFE) supplied; all SAFE conclusion_types available; FidelityTrace records S_old=UNSAFE; S_new=SAFE

description: Human authority semantics not encoded as automated decision
setup: Inspect all Advisory output objects; inspect GovernanceConfig
expected_outcome: Advisory.type ∈ R; no field named approved/prohibited/override/decision; Go advisory ≠ departure approval; empty advisory list ≠ prohibition

description: UNSAFE episode emits FidelityTrace with empty advisory types
expected_outcome: FidelityTrace: state=UNSAFE; G=0; A_AI=∅; active_rule_ids=[]; fired_rule_ids=[]; generated_advisory_types=[]
